metadata.question: Did did the total rainfall exceed 6 inches in Grafton, New South Wales during January 14, 2020 to January 22, 2020?

data.raw_code: 1. Search strategy: - Location: Grafton, New South Wales, Australia (approximately -29.69°S, 152.93°E) - Date range: January 14, 2020 to January 22, 2020 - Collection: CHIRPS daily precipitation data (most reliable for rainfall) - Alternative: GPM IMERG if CHIRPS fails 2. Masking strategy: - No cloud masking needed for precipitation products (they're already processed) - Just need to sum up the daily precipitation values 3. Logic to distinguish Valid Zero (A/B) from Null/Error (C3): - Valid Zero (0-6 inches) → B (No, didn't exceed 6 inches) - Valid >6 inches → A (Yes, exceeded 6 inches) - No images found → C1 - Calculation returns None/NaN → C3 - Convert mm to inches (1 inch = 25.4 mm, so 6 inches = 152.4 mm) ```javascript const ee = require('@google/earthengine'); const privateKey = require('../auth_keys/test-project-473922-29f05d49bed7'); async function runAnalysis() { // 1. Geometry & Time Definitions const grafton = ee.Geometry.Point([152.93, -29.69]); const startDate = '2020-01-14'; const endDate = '2020-01-23'; // exclusive end date // 2. Data Acquisition & Check const chirps = ee.ImageCollection('UCSB-CHG/CHIRPS/DAILY') .filterBounds(grafton) .filterDate(startDate, endDate); const imageCount = chirps.size().getInfo(); console.log(`CHIRPS Images found: ${imageCount}`); if (imageCount === 0) { console.log("No data available for the specified period."); console.log("C1"); return; } // 3. Processing - Sum all daily precipitation const totalPrecip = chirps.select('precipitation').sum(); // 4. Calculation - Get total rainfall in mm const stats = totalPrecip.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.mean(), geometry: grafton, scale: 5566, maxPixels: 1e9 }).getInfo(); const totalMm = stats.precipitation; // 5. Validation & Final Answer if (totalMm === null || totalMm === undefined || isNaN(totalMm)) { console.log("Calculation failed - invalid result"); console.log("C3"); return; } const totalInches = totalMm / 25.4; const threshold = 6.0; console.log(`Total rainfall: ${totalMm.toFixed(2)} mm (${totalInches.toFixed(2)} inches)`); console.log(`Threshold: ${threshold} inches (${(threshold * 25.4).toFixed(2)} mm)`); console.log(`Period: ${startDate} to ${endDate}`); if (totalInches > threshold) { console.log("A"); } else { console.log("B"); } } async function initEE() { await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.data.authenticateViaPrivateKey(privateKey, resolve, reject); }); await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.initialize(null, null, resolve, reject); }); await runAnalysis(); } initEE(); ```
